_metadata.description: Path-by-path comparison of candidate 1.1 against real live-engine output. Every target below is COMPUTED from the comparison, never asserted.

oracle.captured_by: running the real Dart implementation, not a reimplementation

comparison_keys.options: labels, for roles whose live FollowupQuestion carries options: additional_symptoms, red_flag_clarifier
comparison_keys.options_not_compared: severity and duration carry an empty options list in the live Dart model — their answers come from the severity slider and duration chips. There is nothing to compare, and no match is claimed.
comparison_keys.tokens: set of tokens any presented answer could produce
comparison_keys.red_flags: set of red-flag tokens whose clarifier is presented

coverage_limits: Token subsets are bounded at size 3 over the 24 driving tokens (2,325 paths). Larger selections are representable in the app and are NOT covered here.
The 24 driving tokens are those that reach a follow-up question or a clarifier trigger. The other 97 picker tokens exercise only the default-duration fallback, which IS covered.
Demographic gating (sex, age, pregnancy) does not affect follow-up selection in the live engine and is not varied here.
Answer VALUES are not varied: the live engine computes the question set before any follow-up answer exists. IM-003 would change that, and is not implemented.
